Method of Attack: Remote Access Trojan (RAT) using Tor proxies to redirect traffic to Tor hidden servers
Distributed via spam emails with malicious Word file containing macro script
Macro downloads and installs AthenaGo RAT
Supports commands to list directories, list processes, kill processes, download files, execute downloaded files, and run system commands
Communicates with C&C server via tor2web.org proxy service to hide C&C server location
Attack Vector: Spam emails with malicious Word document containing macro
